title: Economic priorities in the current provisional profile
intended_interpretation: Summarize the authored responses about ownership, financing, access and service delivery, with statement and scenario summaries shown separately. These topics are grouped by the current implementation; the content audit recommends separating their meanings.
evidence_required: Applicable instrument 0.4.0 answers, authored direction and option scores, evidence counts, and exclusion of the repeated housing case. A construct argument and participant evidence are required before treating the summary as one economic trait.
unsupported_inferences: Public funding, public ownership, competition and worker control are not interchangeable. A cooperative is not inherently moderate. The mean does not establish a party identity, economic ideology or policy competence.

title: Shared obligations in the current provisional profile
intended_interpretation: Describe responses grouped around obligations beyond borders, domestic priority and international cooperation. Preserve distinctions between special duties, practical shared benefits and delegated authority when interpreting the separate statement and scenario summaries.
evidence_required: Applicable scored statements and the water-partnership and regional-cooperation responses, with counts and original choices. Interviews and reviewed construct evidence are needed to determine which motive or institutional commitment the answers express.
unsupported_inferences: Agreement with cooperation does not establish equal priority for outsiders, acceptance of supranational authority or the respondent's nationality. The grouping is not a validated nationalism–cosmopolitanism scale.

title: Civil protections in the current provisional profile
intended_interpretation: Describe the current provisional grouping of protected dissent, official discretion and independent review. Its transparency statements require explicit caution because administrative disclosure and civil-protection commitments may differ.
evidence_required: Applicable scored statement responses and public-assembly choice. The descriptive public-records scenario must remain excluded. The audit of civil-records and civil-withholding is unresolved; current scoring is recorded rather than endorsed by this catalog.
unsupported_inferences: A preference about paperwork, noise or predictable rules does not establish authoritarianism, support for repression or a general civil-liberties disposition. One scored scenario cannot establish broad coverage.

title: Cultural continuity in the current provisional profile
intended_interpretation: Describe choices and statements about preserving, revising and widening participation in public cultural programs. The implemented summary concerns this narrow authored subject matter.
evidence_required: Applicable authored statements, community-festival and community-history choices, their reasons and evidence counts. Review is needed to separate preservation, equal access, inclusion and replacement.
unsupported_inferences: These responses do not establish a general attitude toward all social change, religion, gender, migration or moral conservatism. An open selection process does not guarantee replacement of an inherited practice.

title: Existing premises: social explanation
intended_interpretation: Retain each response about agency, social relations, productive power and ecological dependence as a separate description of the respondent's stated premise.
evidence_required: The four individual premise responses, uncertainty and skips, plus paraphrases showing whether each answer concerns possibility, explanation or moral approval.
unsupported_inferences: These four heterogeneous statements are not an ontology total or an ideology classifier. Agreement with social formation does not deny agency, and ecological dependence does not establish a conservation policy.

title: Existing premises: grounds of obligation
intended_interpretation: Retain separate responses about pursuing a good life, protection from uncontrolled power, care obligations and obligations through community membership.
evidence_required: Individual item responses and clarification of the duty bearer, affected people and meaning of freedom or obligation.
unsupported_inferences: Acceptance of several obligations is compatible. No score establishes which obligation would dominate a concrete conflict, which institution should deliver it or which tradition the person belongs to.

title: Existing premises: sources and tests of knowledge
intended_interpretation: Record individual judgments about dispersed information, tacit knowledge, situated experience and revisability of explanations.
evidence_required: Item-level responses and probes separating a source of insight from infallibility or a right to govern.
unsupported_inferences: The four statements are not an expertise-versus-experience scale. Agreement does not establish research literacy, epistemic virtue, a preferred coordination system or a single political identity.

title: Existing premises: institutional mechanisms
intended_interpretation: Record individual responses about property as independence, workplace control, contestable power and gradual reform.
evidence_required: Each authored response with clarification of the powers, property types, decision rights and assumed consequences the reader imagined.
unsupported_inferences: The category is not an institutional ideology score. Participation is not identical to ownership, gradual change is not necessarily conservative attachment, and a preferred mechanism does not prove it is effective.

title: How political interests and goals are explained
intended_interpretation: Describe the separate weight a respondent gives to interests attributed from economic position, people's own reasons, and institutions that help form goals.
evidence_required: Responses to CR-01A/B/C plus paraphrases distinguishing interests, goals, explanations and social influence. Ask which society or example grounds the judgment.
unsupported_inferences: The cluster does not directly test the ability to dissent, measure agency or establish an individualist/collectivist identity. First-person explanations and social formation can both matter.

title: Sources and persistence of political power
intended_interpretation: Describe beliefs about business ownership beyond voting, bargaining among groups, and public officials' capacity to develop an independent power base.
evidence_required: Responses to CR-02A/B/C with examples of mechanisms and clarification of whether the claim concerns a possible state, most states or a specific society.
unsupported_inferences: Explanatory beliefs do not indicate approval of inequality, denial of elections, support for authoritarian government or membership in a class-based political tradition.

title: Different meanings of freedom
intended_interpretation: Describe whether the respondent counts unthreatened agreement, secure means to meet needs and protection from unreviewable dismissal as aspects of freedom.
evidence_required: Responses to CR-03A/B/C and probes about alternatives, resources, standing power and effective appeal. Keep each proposition separate.
unsupported_inferences: The three responses do not form a validated freedom continuum. A judgment that an action is free does not establish that it is fair; concern about domination does not identify a preferred ownership system.

title: Desert, need and care-based obligation
intended_interpretation: Distinguish judgments about deserved earnings under equal formal rules, public support based on need rather than contribution, and stronger personal duties within care relationships.
evidence_required: Responses to CR-04A/B/C with clarification of contribution, effective support, deserving versus legal entitlement and the difference between a person's duty and a public official's mandate.
unsupported_inferences: A person's care duties cannot be generalized to a state's obligations. The cluster is not a generosity score, compassion test or complete theory of distributive justice.

title: Claims to govern economic enterprises
intended_interpretation: Describe the decision rights a respondent supports for non-working owners, workers and essential-service users.
evidence_required: Responses to CR-05A/B/C and concrete examples of the decisions, voting powers, investment expectations and affected groups the reader imagines.
unsupported_inferences: Owner control, worker majority control and user representation are different arrangements, not positions on a public/private ownership scale. These responses do not select a complete economic system.

title: Evidential priorities and coordination knowledge
intended_interpretation: Describe default judgments about statistical studies, experience of exclusion and limits on collecting dispersed information.
evidence_required: Responses to CR-06A/B/C, reasons for trusting each source, and probes about reliability, common outcomes and what would change the respondent's judgment.
unsupported_inferences: Agreement is not evidence of scientific competence, rejection of expertise, group infallibility or a uniquely market-based coordination preference. Underspecified source quality may explain an answer.

title: Continuity, reform and transition risk
intended_interpretation: Distinguish presumptions favoring inherited institutions, reasons to replace exclusionary institutions and a preference for reversible reform steps.
evidence_required: Responses to CR-07A/B/C with the imagined harm of delay, meaning of institutional improvement and assumptions about transition risk made explicit.
unsupported_inferences: Gradualism does not by itself identify conservatism; support for replacement does not establish support for violence. Different answers may reflect different assumed risks rather than different principles.

title: Membership, inclusion and collective self-rule
intended_interpretation: Describe commitments concerning special duties to citizens, political membership without cultural assimilation and collective self-rule beyond protected individual rights.
evidence_required: Responses to CR-08A/B/C plus explanations of citizenship, residence, culture, who constitutes a political community and who counts as an outsider.
unsupported_inferences: The cluster is not one nationalism–globalism axis and cannot infer nationality, immigration preferences or endorsement of every secession claim.

title: Religion and reasons for binding public rules
intended_interpretation: Distinguish religious teaching as sufficient justification, publicly assessable reasons across faiths, and public funding for majority-religion worship under stipulated equal belief freedom.
evidence_required: Responses to CR-09A/B/C with probes separating moral justification, legal authorization, religious motivation, worship funding and freedom of belief.
unsupported_inferences: The answers do not measure personal religiosity, theological belief, tolerance in every context or support for exclusive majority funding. Religious traditions are not uniform positions.

title: Inherited exclusion and grounds for repair
intended_interpretation: Describe judgments about need versus birth-assigned group membership in remedial support, responsibility through continuing benefit and guaranteed representation after exclusion.
evidence_required: Responses to CR-10A/B/C and clear readings of inherited hierarchy, the basis of responsibility, group definitions and how representatives would be selected.
unsupported_inferences: Caste, race, class and colonial relations cannot be treated as interchangeable. These generic drafts do not establish a complete view of any affected community, its history or the correct remedy.

title: Ecological standing and limits on tradeoffs
intended_interpretation: Describe whether nonhuman systems, future generations and ecological constraints provide political reasons that may limit present benefits.
evidence_required: Responses to CR-11A/B/C with explanations of human benefit, moral duty, who bears present sacrifice and what counts as a non-substitutable ecological limit.
unsupported_inferences: These responses do not establish a position on all economic growth, equal sacrifice by all households, a specific environmental policy or an Indigenous political identity.

title: Grounds and limits of binding authority
intended_interpretation: Distinguish revocable powers, performance as a possible basis of legitimacy without competitive elections, and a presumption for voluntary coordination.
evidence_required: Responses to CR-12A/B/C with probes distinguishing legitimacy from legal power, removing a leader from revoking a power, and voluntary coordination from its expected feasibility.
unsupported_inferences: No single response establishes an authoritarian personality, acceptance of repression, a preferred regime in every circumstance or a complete anarchist/libertarian identity.

title: Housing governance: exit, voice and individual appeal
intended_interpretation: Describe the consultation package favored when municipal ownership is fixed and residents can gain moving assistance, collective rule approval or individual review. Retain the reason separately.
evidence_required: The CR-S01 action, its stated reason, understood consultation authority and the exact base or variant facts shown. The variant needs a planned design before estimating an effect.
unsupported_inferences: A moving grant does not necessarily indicate market ideology; collective voice and individual appeal do not uniquely identify traditions. Choice changes cannot identify a causal role effect or a definitive belief about non-domination.

title: Respite allocation: recipient needs, carer needs and equal additions
intended_interpretation: Describe the allocation rule favored when total additional care capacity is fixed and recipient needs partly overlap with carer exhaustion.
evidence_required: The CR-S02 choice and reason, understanding of the 20/20/10 overlap, freedom to refuse care and the fixed present willingness of carers. Record the history-of-consent version.
unsupported_inferences: The choice does not measure compassion or preference for public versus private provision. Prior consent does not establish present coercion, and care responsibilities must not be assumed to belong to women or relatives.

title: Comprehension of the relationship between evidence and its purpose
intended_interpretation: Investigate whether a reader distinguishes the authorized research purpose from the types of claim each sampling method can support. CR-S03 is held as a comprehension probe pending redesign.
evidence_required: An uncoached CR-S03 response, explanation of what the selected sample can establish, and a record of whether average exposure or localized peaks was the mandated primary task.
unsupported_inferences: This probe supplies no ideological indicator or assessment score. A response may reflect method–purpose matching, unfamiliarity with sampling or a reading of the member mandate rather than a political commitment.

title: Standing in a shared fund: membership and contribution
intended_interpretation: Describe whether equal eligibility, longer residence or documented contribution receives priority in a fixed public grant lottery.
evidence_required: The CR-S04 choice, reason, understanding of the two-stage lotteries and confirmation that newer households are not assumed to be foreign. Record the funding-origin version while preserving the accumulation period.
unsupported_inferences: Residence preference is not necessarily ethnic nationalism; contribution priority is not a judgment of human worth. The variant does not isolate nationality, ancestry, immigration or culture.

title: Ecological loss, employment and responsibility under risk
intended_interpretation: Describe the chosen tradeoff between specified local jobs and the risk of losing an ecological community under a national recommendation mandate.
evidence_required: The CR-S05 package and reason, comprehension of probability ranges and background versus project-caused risk, and the local-loss or species-extinction version shown.
unsupported_inferences: The choice cannot separate intrinsic ecological value from all future human interests, establish an attitude toward growth generally or predict decisions in a real country. Confidence in estimates is a rival explanation.

title: Course access: present need, equal procedure and institutional repair
intended_interpretation: Describe whether a training association's limited places are allocated through equal chance, a response to its own exclusionary history or current low-income priority.
evidence_required: The CR-S06 choice and reason, understanding of overlapping applicant groups and the exact prior-remedy condition. Ask whether admission is viewed as an appropriate form of repair.
unsupported_inferences: A lottery preference can coexist with support for a different remedy. The scenario does not establish a complete view of caste, race, merit, colonialism or whether a previous agreement extinguishes every obligation.

title: Chosen action within an assigned responsibility
intended_interpretation: Retain the actual option, uncertainty, unrepresented response or skip under the scenario's stated role, powers and constraints. A reason is a separate unscored explanation.
evidence_required: An authored scenario/version, assigned fictional world, selected response category, option and any voluntarily provided reason.
unsupported_inferences: A role action is not an authentic-ideology diagnosis, evidence of consistency or hypocrisy, or a causal effect of role. The dilemma and role are bundled in the current route.

title: Optional personal preference under unchanged facts
intended_interpretation: Record a separately offered preference among the same feasible packages while setting aside the assigned responsibility. Describe whether a stated preference and role action differ.
evidence_required: Both responses where supplied, their distinct response categories, and confirmation that resources, permissions and material facts were held fixed.
unsupported_inferences: Missing preference does not mean agreement. A difference does not identify hypocrisy, a more authentic self, or a causal role effect; fixed prompt order may influence answers.

title: Descriptive response comparison when repair urgency changes
intended_interpretation: Describe whether the selected housing package differs between the urgent and planned repair conditions while their shared facts and options remain fixed.
evidence_required: Both housing-urgent and housing-planned responses in the recorded fixed order, their version and common scenario facts. Missing or non-choice responses remain distinct.
unsupported_inferences: The repeated case contributes no additional aggregate score. A within-person difference is not an individual causal urgency estimate, a test of ideological consistency or a pure role effect.

title: Transparency, usable access and administrative capacity
intended_interpretation: Describe the balance favored between access to non-sensitive decision information, usability and available staff effort. Keep legal disclosure duties distinct from optional additional publication.
evidence_required: The specific statement or public-records scenario response, the interpreted legal floor and form of access, and the administrative cost the reader understood.
unsupported_inferences: This is not an established civil-rights/public-order measure. The public-records scenario remains descriptive; the current civil-records and civil-withholding statement scores are recorded as existing behavior, not endorsed by this mapping.

title: Question interpretation and bilingual response fit
intended_interpretation: Identify where readers interpret a different claim, invent a material fact, misunderstand authority or cannot express their answer with the offered categories. Record differences between English and Vietnamese readings.
evidence_required: Neutral item probes, exact wording and language order, observed interpretation, response-category meaning and a documented revision/recheck record.
unsupported_inferences: An author draft, passing structural check or fluent translation is not evidence of human comprehension, semantic equivalence, population representativeness or measurement validity. Review observations are not political scores.

title: Independence, choice, and usable access
intended_interpretation: Record separate meanings of independence, priority for access, and the relation between standards and actual participation.
evidence_required: Item-level responses to CR-13A/B/C/D, paraphrases, imagined cost and service assumptions, and disability-led wording review.
unsupported_inferences: No disability-attitude score, legal-capacity judgment, empathy rating, institutional ideology, or validated capability measure follows from these answers.

title: Household consent, care entitlement, and resource authority
intended_interpretation: Distinguish judgments about freely agreed task divisions, claims from unpaid care, cash-based authority, and inferences about natural inclinations.
evidence_required: Each statement response plus the reader's definition of household, free agreement, entitlement, and evidence. Preserve explanatory and normative answers separately.
unsupported_inferences: No gender identity, family diagnosis, feminist/conservative classification, or approval of unequal legal status can be inferred from the cluster as a whole.

title: Units and relations of social reality
intended_interpretation: Describe whether and how the reader distinguishes institutional continuity, collective goals, relational class positions, and group self-recognition.
evidence_required: Separate responses, concrete examples, and paraphrases distinguishing literal existence from legal convention, explanatory convenience, and moral legitimacy.
unsupported_inferences: No ontology total, methodological competence score, Marxist/liberal identity, or inference that disagreement denies human agency. No claim that ontology alone determines political choice.

title: Control, support quantity, and shared governance
intended_interpretation: Explore the reason for choosing individual provider control, pooled support hours, or collective service governance under equal cost and protected consent.
evidence_required: Chosen package, optional personal preference, selected or volunteered reason, hour-budget comprehension, and understanding that existing support is unchanged.
unsupported_inferences: No judgment of respect for disabled people, decisional capacity, personal welfare, or causal role effect; no superiority of the authored packages is established.

title: Who controls additional household resources
intended_interpretation: Describe the balance among care-based entitlement, equal personal shares, and jointly authorized spending for a fixed grant.
evidence_required: Vote, reason, knowledge of account controls and equal totals, and clarification of assumptions about coercion, gender, marriage, and care.
unsupported_inferences: No inference about the reader's own household, gender prejudice, complete family-law preference, generosity, or authentic-versus-role beliefs.

title: Responsibility carried by people, an organization, or a relationship
intended_interpretation: Probe how a reader understands the continuity of commitments across personnel changes and why one responsible unit is preferred.
evidence_required: Choice, reason, paraphrase of all three responsible units, understanding of unchanged water rights, and explicit distinction between legal practicality and a claim about social existence.
unsupported_inferences: No direct ontology classification, claim of a collective mind, ideology label, causal turnover effect, or conclusion that one legal form is generally more effective. Hold as comprehension-only if the intended distinction is not understood.

title: Grounds and limits of emergency authority
intended_interpretation: Describe separate judgments about extra-legal executive discretion, prior authorization despite delay, expiry and renewal burdens, and permission to use unverified local knowledge. Record the imagined threat and power rather than treating the cluster as a single emergency-authority scale.
evidence_required: Item-level CR-15A/B/C/D responses, uncertainty and skips, plus paraphrases identifying what counts as authority, temporary power, legal limitation, and local deviation. Use the scenario only for its narrower lawful coordination contrast; independently review source links and both language drafts.
unsupported_inferences: No authoritarianism diagnosis, regime preference, approval of arbitrary repression, country identification, willingness to violate non-derogable rights, or causal role effect follows. Claims about legal permission and moral justification are not interchangeable; the statement set is not a scored continuum.

title: Coordination and review under a bounded emergency power
intended_interpretation: Describe the selected lawful road-closure arrangement and stated reason, preserving its particular combination of central coordination, local discretion, and timing of independent review. Record any optional personal preference separately.
evidence_required: CR-S09 action, optional reason and personal preference, comprehension of the 48-hour expiry and shared protections, forecast interpretation, and explicit recognition of each package's tradeoff. Author the proposed variant fully and review it before use; a variant instruction is not observed evidence.
unsupported_inferences: The selected package does not reveal a uniquely liberal, authoritarian, federalist, or statist identity. It does not test extra-legal action, estimate a stable willingness to sacrifice rights, or identify the cause of a role/preference difference. No forecast accuracy or harm outcome is measured.

title: Consent, collective effects, and governance of data-based decisions
intended_interpretation: Describe separately the reach assigned to individual permission, affected-public decision rights, human reconsideration under fixed eligibility rules, and purpose-bound public-interest use without universal permission. Preserve which source of authorization or remedy is being endorsed.
evidence_required: Individual CR-16A/B/C/D responses and probes distinguishing a contributor from an affected person, prediction from legitimate allocation, consultation from binding authority, and review from a guarantee of favorable treatment. Independent content and bilingual comprehension review remain required.
unsupported_inferences: No privacy-versus-progress score, technology competence estimate, view about every use of AI, political ideology, or endorsement of a real data program follows. The normative source principles are not validation evidence, and technical accuracy does not demonstrate fairness or consent.

title: Authority over shared data with effects on non-contributors
intended_interpretation: Describe which additional governance package the respondent chooses within the coalition's limited authority, with reasons about contributor control, affected residents, independent enforcement, participation burden, or minority protection kept distinct.
evidence_required: CR-S10 package, optional reason and personal preference, comprehension of common consent/withdrawal rules and collective effects, and explanation of the difference between a binding panel and an advisory panel. The latter is only a proposed editorial variant until fully authored and reviewed.
unsupported_inferences: No action uniquely identifies a tradition or establishes that a person understands data science. The choice does not establish approval of unlawful surveillance, rejection of all data sharing, or a causal effect of civil-society leadership. It provides no observation of human-review preferences for individual eligibility decisions.

title: Standards of warrant, disagreement, and evaluative judgment
intended_interpretation: Describe separate standards the respondent accepts for expecting a pattern to continue, adjusting confidence under informed disagreement, recognizing explanatory knowledge without exact individual prediction, and separating consequences from their evaluative ranking.
evidence_required: CR-22A/B/C/D responses and neutral paraphrases clarifying reliability, peerhood, explanation, individual prediction, and importance. Identify contextual qualifications and evidence that would change the answer. The proposed readings and both language versions still require independent review.
unsupported_inferences: No scientific-literacy grade, relativism diagnosis, pro-science or anti-science identity, political ideology, or one-dimensional epistemology score follows. Several claims can be accepted together. Agreement with the author is not comprehension, and awareness of uncertainty does not require political inaction.

title: Acting while causal explanation and policy priorities remain distinct
intended_interpretation: Describe the support package selected under unresolved observational evidence and the stated practical or epistemic reason, keeping the respondent’s causal judgment, confidence, and optional personal preference separate.
evidence_required: CR-S16 action, reason if offered, neutral paraphrases of the association and competing explanations, and a separately recorded statement of causal confidence. Check whether the reader recognizes that different values can support the same action and that practical action need not certify a cause.
unsupported_inferences: No package establishes methodological competence, science denial, epistemic virtue, or a stable causal-reasoning trait. The task does not estimate the effects of reminders or compare actual program effectiveness. An unreconciled editorial variant supplies no observation and cannot be allocated as a completed alternate form.

title: Standing within and beyond shared-resource self-government
intended_interpretation: Retain separate judgments about stewardship, equal current-user standing, regional uniformity and affected non-users. Compare the stated basis of authority with the circumstances respondents assume.
evidence_required: Responses to CR-17A/B/C/D plus paraphrases of membership, contribution, final authority and a binding say. Ask about the relation between protected individual rights and collective authority; obtain specific community and source review before any broader claim.
unsupported_inferences: No self-rule score, sovereignty diagnosis, Indigenous-identity inference, ethnic preference or ranking of local and national political cultures. Agreement with multiple propositions can be coherent.

title: Choosing a shared-resource governance arrangement
intended_interpretation: Describe the chosen distribution of decision rights, its acknowledged administrative and representational costs, and the reason selected in the reservoir pilot.
evidence_required: Recorded package, selected reason, optional personal preference, paraphrase of authority and equal access, and any objection that downstream residents lack a binding voice. Any variant comparison must preserve its stated conditions and acknowledge order effects.
unsupported_inferences: The choice does not identify a tradition or measure Indigenous sovereignty, civic competence or tolerance of domination. Different options bundle different decision and deadlock rules; no causal effect or universal governance preference follows.

title: Work-related risk, bargaining exit and costly solidarity
intended_interpretation: Describe views on whether control over hours or payment entails risk, whether collective bargaining constrains individual exit, and whether support is owed without personal gain. Keep these claims separate.
evidence_required: Responses to CR-18A/B/C/D with clarification of control, expected income losses, realistic alternatives, collective authorization and the affordability of sacrifice. Review wording with workers under different work arrangements.
unsupported_inferences: No legal employment classification, union-membership inference, class-consciousness score, moral ranking, prediction of strike action or identification of an economic ideology. Support for collective action and individual safeguards can coexist.

title: Priorities in a voluntary workers’ support fund
intended_interpretation: Record which feasible use of a shared fund the respondent chooses and whether their stated reason concerns immediate need, bargaining power, alternatives, solidarity or expected effectiveness.
evidence_required: Chosen program, selected reason, optional personal preference, understanding of the fixed fund and voluntary participation, and explicit recognition that a meeting or customer service does not guarantee improved pay.
unsupported_inferences: The choice does not establish selfishness, genuine versus role-constrained politics, union support in every legal context or a causal effect of negotiation access. Package differences in timing and beneficiaries must remain visible.

title: Preferred forms of inquiry and authority over research questions
intended_interpretation: Describe the separate weight given to comparative evidence for causal claims, situated meaning, historical formation and affected people’s authority to shape inquiry. Record conditional combinations and methodological purpose explicitly.
evidence_required: Responses to CR-23A/B/C/D with paraphrases of what is being investigated, what each approach can and cannot show, and when another approach would be useful. Methods-source review and interviews must distinguish political commitments from technical vocabulary or assumed study quality.
unsupported_inferences: No quantitative-versus-qualitative identity, methods-literacy score, ranking of intelligence, general epistemic virtue or political ideology. These approaches are neither exhaustive nor mutually exclusive. Descriptive responses cannot establish the validity of a method or source.

title: Selecting an inquiry under limited research resources
intended_interpretation: Record which research plan the respondent prioritizes for the broad transport question, the reason selected, the recognized limits and any preference for a combination or different sequence.
evidence_required: Chosen plan, selected reason, optional personal preference, understanding of available records and authority, and neutral probes distinguishing comparison, interpretation, historical explanation and participatory question-setting. Preserve the broad purpose and all package limitations in any report.
unsupported_inferences: The choice is not a correct-answer test, a validated methodology scale, a political identity or evidence that any proposed study would succeed. A preference for option C cannot separately identify historical and participatory commitments. A changed response to missing archives does not show ideological inconsistency.

title: Production, distribution and economic coordination
intended_interpretation: Record separate judgments on how should people understand productive capacity, contributions, reinvestment and control of the surplus generated by shared work? Preserve disagreements and rival interpretations at item level.
evidence_required: Individual statement responses with clarification of terms, counterexamples, and the respondent’s own explanation; independent bilingual review and interviews are required before assessment use.
unsupported_inferences: Output, profits and surplus may be read as the same amount; specify necessary costs and avoid assuming that unpaid care always increases measured output. None of the four statements implies a policy or a single economic axis. Do not classify ideology or aggregate into an unvalidated score.

title: Material organization, institutions and cultural change
intended_interpretation: Record separate judgments on when economic arrangements, laws, and shared beliefs change, which can influence the others, and how much independence can each retain? Preserve disagreements and rival interpretations at item level.
evidence_required: Individual statement responses with clarification of terms, counterexamples, and the respondent’s own explanation; independent bilingual review and interviews are required before assessment use.
unsupported_inferences: The term economic arrangements must be clarified through examples. Agreement with an explanatory proposition does not mean approval of inequality or denial of independent legal and cultural influence. Avoid implying a universal theory or treating a correlation as proof. Do not classify ideology or aggregate into an unvalidated score.

title: Who decides how a shared facility is used?
intended_interpretation: Describe the chosen feasible package, stated reasons and optional personal preference within the specified role and resource constraints.
evidence_required: Complete scenario action, selected reasons, optional preference and clarification of the facts the respondent used; uncertainty and no-option answers remain distinct.
unsupported_inferences: A choice may reflect productive expectations, income needs, participation or practical confidence; no option uniquely signals a political identity. The committee does not determine ownership. The proposed fixed forecasts require independent feasibility review.

title: Funding a public learning initiative
intended_interpretation: Describe the chosen feasible package, stated reasons and optional personal preference within the specified role and resource constraints.
evidence_required: Complete scenario action, selected reasons, optional preference and clarification of the facts the respondent used; uncertainty and no-option answers remain distinct.
unsupported_inferences: Choice reflects allocation under a fixed authorization, not proof of a causal theory of culture or economy. Groups and independent teams may hold many viewpoints, and all projects must preserve existing rights. Review whether the specified coverage can be financed under both variants.

title: International-system explanations
intended_interpretation: Describe separate judgments about repeated interaction, security uncertainty, shared meanings and unequal bargaining.
evidence_required: Individual responses and probes about intentions, capabilities, agreements, alternative explanations and the assumed time period.
unsupported_inferences: Responses cannot identify realism, liberalism, constructivism, nationality, international-law expertise or a single IR scale.

title: Flood cooperation under bounded authority
intended_interpretation: Describe the selected cooperation package and stated reason under fixed costs and available participation.
evidence_required: The chosen package, separate reason, optional personal preference, understood constraints and any uncertainty or skip.
unsupported_inferences: A single choice cannot identify a theoretical school, prove cooperation is effective, or establish a causal role effect.
